message: Research 8+ hands-off product channels, rank by EV to A0 by Dec 21, build top pick to ready-to-list

Repo/toolchain survey: no Rust (coordinator vetoed install - needs parent OK); VS2022+MSVC x64 present; Node26/Py3.13/requests available; cadence+4 other Toom68 repos have no licence file but Thomas owns copyright so paid builds are allowed
Apify OSM-lead niche rejected as top pick: direct competitors have 1-6 monthly users (apifystats data); payout would land Dec 21-25 at best

Top pick: chiptune sample pack on itch.io (+Bandcamp mirror) - instant PayPal payout, real browse traffic, fully agent-buildable with stdlib Python; pick 2: cadence paid build pending Rust toolchain approval
Wrote products/research.md (14 channels evaluated with evidence) and products/plan.md (pick1: chiptune pack on itch+Bandcamp; pick2: cadence build runbook for parent)
Built pocket-chip-kit: 82 WAVs + 12 MIDIs (84s audio), verify_pack.py PASS (0 failures), cover.png via headless Chrome, preview.html renders; zip 2.7MB ready to list

Task complete: research.md (14 channels, evidence-linked), plan.md (pick1 pocket-chip-kit itch+Bandcamp US.99 PWYW ready-to-list; pick2 cadence build runbook blocked on rustup approval), pack built+verified (82 wav+12 mid, zip 2.7MB). Parent must: create itch account, connect PayPal, upload zip+copy (~20min). Optional Bandcamp/Gumroad mirrors. Combined P(>=A0 by Dec21) ~10-16% if cadence also ships, ~7-12% pack alone.
Execute plan.md pick 2: build cadence release for Windows in private/cadence (read-only clone), package zip -> private/products/cadence, smoke test exe, commit listing assets under products/cadence

cadence 1.1.0 release build OK (2m10s): --version/list-instruments OK, --render-demo wrote 18.5s WAV (3.9MB) in 0.81s, GUI launched 'Afterglow - Cadence' Responding=True, window-only screenshot captured via PrintWindow, process closed cleanly

Pick 2 complete: Cadence-1.1.0-windows-x64.zip (4.0MB) in products/cadence with screenshot.png + cover.png + LISTING.md + BUILD-NOTES.md; exe verified headless (demo render) and GUI (opened, screenshot, closed). Thomas: upload zip on itch.io as Tool/Windows, US PWYW, Direct-to-you PayPal.
